metas.name: 2026 · Kill Jackie
metas.description: Ex-cocaine dealer Jackie Price lives luxuriously selling art through tax schemes. After 20 years of anonymity, her peaceful life ends when The Seven Demons, elite hitmen, are hired to kill her.

metas.name: ★ 7.5 · 2021 · Professor T
metas.description: Professor Jasper Tempest, a genius Cambridge University criminologist with OCD and an overbearing mother, assists the police in solving crime.

metas.name: ★ 7.1 · 2026 · My Bias, My Boss
metas.description: A romantic comedy about Nam Da Reum, who joins a company led by former idol-turned-CEO Lee Chan, and unexpectedly finds herself in a romance with the company's boss, Kang Ha Gi.

metas.name: ★ 7.5 · 2010 · Mokhtarnameh
metas.description: Mukhtar Thaqafi was a Shiite Muslim leader who sets up a rebellion movement in 686 A.D in the town of Kufa to avenge the martyrdom of Hussain (grandson of Islamic Prophet Muhammad).

metas.name: 2026 · Anna Pigeon
metas.description: Park ranger Anna Pigeon left city life after personal tragedy. Now she channels her pain into investigating crimes in national parks, determined to solve cases despite any obstacles.

metas.name: ★ 7.5 · 2016 · Rostered On
metas.description: "Rostered On" is an independent Australian comedy show based around the day to day struggles of working for a faceless retail corporation "Electroworld".

metas.name: ★ 6.6 · 2026 · Tomb Raider King
metas.description: God-like tombs surface globally, granting magical relics. Betrayed and left for dead, elite hunter Jooheon travels 15 years into the past to loot every tomb, hoard artifacts, and execute revenge.

metas.name: ★ 8.1 · 2026 · The Prosecutor's Proposal
metas.description: A prosecutor and an investigator linked by a decades-old murder uncover corruption while battling an attraction they cannot resist.

metas.name: ★ 7.8 · 2026 · Crystal Lake
metas.description: Prequel series to Friday the 13th, follows a doomed small town where camp counselors come to die.

metas.name: ★ 7.5 · 2026 · Take Charge of My Heart
metas.description: A man whose artificial heart is running out of battery and a woman who has the power to recharge him.

metas.name: 2026 · VisionQuest
metas.description: Vision is faced with many challenges while trying to regain his memory and humanity.

metas.name: 2026 · Avatar: Seven Havens
metas.description: After a world-shattering disaster, a young Earthbender learns she's the post-Korra Avatar. Now seen as a harbinger of doom, she and her twin race to save the Seven Havens while pursued by humans and spirits alike.

metas.name: ★ 8.4 · 2025 · The First Frost
metas.description: Wen Yifan, a reporter, meets Sang Yan, her former high school crush at a bar. Initially pretending not to recognize each other, circumstances lead them to become housemates. They rekindle their love and reconcile the relationship.

metas.name: ★ 8.2 · 2022 · The Lion Skin
metas.description: Naeem, who has endured 15 years in prison for his daughter's love, faces a major crisis after his release to see her.

metas.name: ★ 8.0 · 2015 · Terrace House: Boys & Girls in the City
metas.description: A new set of six men and women start their lives together under one roof. All they get is a fabulous home and a car. As always, there is no script.

metas.name: ★ 7.2 · 2012 · Cuckoo
metas.description: Cuckoo is every parent's worst nightmare - a slacker full of outlandish, New Age ideas.
